name: Caddy
description: Serves a directory of files over HTTP using Caddy's built-in static file server. TLS is the dashboard's own Caddy in front of it, so this one obtains no certificates of its own.

access.note: There is no login and no upload page: anyone who reaches this address can read every file in the site volume. A fresh deploy answers with Caddy's own welcome page, because Docker seeds the empty volume from the image; put your own files in with the dashboard's file manager, and keep an index.html at the root or requests to / answer 403.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: The address other people open. Nothing inside the container reads it.

update.notes: Stateless apart from the site files; the served directory carries over between versions.
